payload.title: Freeze the human-label arXiv study protocol and source manifest
payload.description:
## Scope and acceptance
Pin dataset revision and stable ID/hash manifest; show title, abstract, date, categories, authors and publication reference if available. Verify actual total request budget, not assume all abstracts fit alongside examples/tasks. Keep article text/local human comments private. Declare splits before labels; audit for monitoring only, not candidate selection, and permanent holdout unseen by optimizer/fitter. Predict before vote; timestamp labels and versions; rubric drift/corrections reported. Define warm-up/class coverage, development promotion rule, random audit sampling/propensities, intervals and review-rate floor before live collection.
